create_tool_subclass: create a python subclass of Tool that implements the abstract call method with custom kwargs
instantiate_tooloutput: create a ToolOutput dataclass instance with text and optional images for tool results
instantiate_example: create an Example dataclass instance with query, tool_kwargs, result, and answer fields
get_tool_name: call the name cached property on a Tool subclass instance to get its lowercase class name
get_tool_argnames: call the tool_argnames cached property on a Tool instance to inspect call method parameters
